betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Got a satellite primary function module and a Data Unit? The §6Satellite Builder§f is where you combine them into an actual satellite ready for launch.

Drop the primary function (ore scanner, biome changer, etc.) into the GUI along with a Data Unit, and the builder assembles a satellite item. The motor tier you use in the recipe affects the resulting satellite's scan speed, so go higher if you want faster data collection.

This machine is networked, so it links up with your §6Satellite Control Center§f to track what's in orbit. Every orbital science mission in AR starts here, whether you're mapping ores on distant planets or changing biomes from space.

§ePS:§f Pair with a Data Unit from the Crystallizer (quest 10006) for maximum storage on the resulting satellite.
